title.zh-CN: 胸闷后意识丧失 · 66岁女性
title.en: Loss of consciousness after chest tightness · 66-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 一位住院中的女性胸闷后很快呼之不应、心脏骤停，抢救后仍未清醒：读懂一份不同寻常的心电图，决定先做什么、再做什么，并陪家属面对此后的病程。
summary.en: An inpatient stops responding soon after chest tightness, goes into cardiac arrest and stays unconscious after resuscitation: make sense of an unusual ECG, decide what she needs first and what comes next, and stay with her family through what follows.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在床旁识别镜像右位心（心尖搏动在右侧、心音低弱）并在胸片上确认；加做镜像导联心电图（左右上肢电极互换、胸导联移到右胸对称位置），同时不让它拖延再灌注。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise mirror-image dextrocardia at the bedside (a right-sided apex beat, faint heart sounds) and confirm it on the chest film; add a mirror-image ECG (arm electrodes swapped, chest electrodes mirrored onto the right chest) without letting it delay reperfusion.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对院内心脏骤停复苏后心电图仍有 ST 段抬高的患者，立即启动直接 PCI 策略——把昏迷纳入获益与风险的权衡，但不把早期昏迷当作治疗徒劳的证据；能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成 PCI 时不选溶栓，并说明 PCI 前全量溶栓的危害（ESC 2023 ACS；ASSENT-4 PCI）。
learningOutcomes.en: Start a primary PCI strategy at once for a patient resuscitated from an in-hospital cardiac arrest whose ECG still shows ST elevation — weighing her coma, but not mistaking an early coma for futility — choosing PCI over fibrinolysis whenever it can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis and explaining the harm of full-dose lysis before PCI (ESC 2023 ACS; ASSENT-4 PCI).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 给予复苏后的首要处置：确保气道并控制通气（SpO₂ 94%–98%、PaCO₂ 正常），平均动脉压 > 60–65 mmHg，贴好除颤电极，持续监测核心体温，在她仍昏迷期间主动预防发热、把体温控制在 37.5 ℃ 及以下 36–72 小时（ERC–ESICM 2025 复苏后治疗指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Deliver the first post-resuscitation priorities — a secured airway with controlled ventilation (SpO₂ 94–98 %, a normal PaCO₂), a mean arterial pressure above 60–65 mmHg, defibrillator pads in place, continuous core-temperature monitoring and active prevention of fever, targeting 37.5 °C or less for 36–72 hours while she remains comatose (ERC–ESICM 2025 post-resuscitation care).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 从造影中找出罪犯血管——有血栓的闭塞血管，而不是导联名称所指的那支——对血流动力学不稳定的患者，急诊手术只处理罪犯病变，把左主干和前降支病变留给心脏团队，并说明为何不常规使用 IABP（ESC 2023 ACS）。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify the culprit artery on the angiogram — the occluded vessel with thrombus, not the one the lead names suggest — treat only the culprit in the emergency procedure of a patient who is not haemodynamically stable, leave the left main and LAD disease to a Heart Team, and explain why an IABP is not routine (ESC 2023 ACS).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明心脏骤停后早期双侧瞳孔散大、对光反射消失为什么不能用来决定治疗，并把多模式神经预后评估安排在复苏后至少 72 小时、排除镇静等干扰之后（ERC–ESICM 2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why dilated pupils without a light reaction shortly after a cardiac arrest must not drive treatment, and schedule multimodal neurological prognostication no earlier than 72 hours after ROSC, once sedation and other confounders are excluded (ERC–ESICM 2025).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 当技术上成功的 PCI 之后出现无尿、酸中毒加重和 DIC 时，用 SPIKES 框架与家属沟通：把现在能判断的（器官衰竭及可提供的支持）与还不能判断的（脑功能预后）分开，并解释 ST 段回落为什么不等于康复。
learningOutcomes.en: When anuria, worsening acidosis and DIC follow a technically successful PCI, talk with the family using SPIKES: separate what can be judged now (the organ failure and the support on offer) from what cannot yet (the brain's recovery), and explain why a fall in the ST elevation is not recovery.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编（原文为中文）。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——66岁女性，当时已在住院，突发胸闷后很快呼之不应、心跳呼吸骤停；复苏并电击 4 次；复苏后的查体；急诊心电图；胸片；冠状动脉造影；先溶栓、后行右冠状动脉支架和 IABP；术后 ST 段回落；无尿、酸中毒加重和 DIC；PCI 后约 10 小时停止抢救并离院——均尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色、床旁的家属以及家属说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、骤停心律和抢救时长、化验数值、未完成的超声心动图和 CT、药物和剂量、离院后的情况）保持未知。保留未解决的不一致：报告标题称为前壁心肌梗死，而 1.0.0 版记录的造影显示右冠状动脉近段闭塞、前降支 TIMI 3 级血流。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report (written in Chinese). Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 66-year-old woman, already in hospital, who developed sudden chest tightness, quickly became unresponsive and had a cardiac and respiratory arrest; resuscitation with four shocks; the examination after it; the emergency ECG; the chest film; the coronary angiogram; thrombolysis, then RCA stenting and an IABP; the fall in ST elevation; anuria, worsening acidosis and DIC; and the end of resuscitation and her leaving hospital about 10 hours after PCI — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff, the relative at her bedside and the relative's voiced worry (teaching devices that add no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, the arrest rhythm and duration, laboratory values, the echocardiography and CT that were not completed, drugs and doses, and what happened after she left) stays unknown. Kept as recorded and not resolved: the report's title calls the infarct anterior, while the angiogram recorded in 1.0.0 shows the proximal RCA occluded and the LAD with TIMI 3 flow.

name.zh-CN: 吴清和的家属（化名）

persona.zh-CN: 她的一位家属，具体关系没有记录，抢救后赶到床旁陪着她。害怕、疲惫，说话直白，用日常的话；知道的只是医生告诉家里的情况，记不住医学名词，也说不出数字；不知道的就直说不知道，从不替她猜。最想知道她还能不能醒过来、心脏会不会再停。
persona.en: A family member — the exact relationship is not recorded — who has come to her bedside after the resuscitation. Frightened and tired, speaks plainly in everyday words; knows only what the doctors have told the family, cannot remember medical terms or give numbers, says so when they do not know and never guesses for her. Above all wants to know whether she will wake up and whether her heart could stop again.

description.zh-CN: 她住院期间感到胸闷，很快呼之不应，随即心跳呼吸骤停；经抢救、电击 4 次后仍未清醒。你在床旁接手：了解经过、查体、记录心电图，并决定先做什么。
description.en: In hospital she felt chest tightness, soon stopped responding and had a cardiac and respiratory arrest; after resuscitation with four shocks she has not woken. You take over at the bedside: find out what happened, examine her, record an ECG and decide what comes first.

description.zh-CN: 根据你的再灌注决定，她已被送到心导管室；从这里开始，病例按记录的实际病程展开。阅读造影，决定这次手术处理什么。
description.en: On your reperfusion decision she has been taken to the catheter laboratory; from here the case follows the recorded course. Read the angiogram and decide what this procedure should treat.

description.zh-CN: 手术结束后，她转入重症监护室。复查心电图、血气和凝血，查看尿量，再与家属谈话。
description.en: After the procedure she is in intensive care. Repeat the ECG, check the blood gas, the clotting and her urine output, then talk with her family.

name.zh-CN: 记录的病程与结局

date.zh-CN: 从发病到 PCI 术后约 10 小时
date.en: From the onset to about 10 hours after PCI

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：66岁女性，当时已在住院，约 1 小时前突然出现胸闷，很快呼之不应，随即心跳呼吸骤停；经抢救、电击 4 次后仍不清醒。发作时面色苍白、发绀，大汗。查体：肢体冰冷、发绀，双侧瞳孔散大、对光反射消失；心尖搏动位于右侧，心音低弱；自主呼吸弱，双肺呼吸音低并有干、湿啰音。急诊心电图：阵发性心房颤动、室性心动过速，前壁导联 ST 段抬高。胸片：镜像右位心，心影增大；超声心动图和 CT 没有完成，心脏的详细结构不清楚。冠状动脉造影：左主干狭窄 70%，前降支弥漫性病变、最重处 85%，TIMI 3 级血流；右冠状动脉近段完全闭塞，局部有血栓。处理：先行溶栓，之后行右冠状动脉支架植入并置入主动脉内球囊反搏（IABP）；这次造影是在溶栓之前还是之后，本病例没有记录。术后 ST 段抬高回落，但她出现无尿、酸中毒加重和弥散性血管内凝血（DIC）。之后停止了进一步抢救，她在 PCI 术后约 10 小时离院；此后的情况，包括是否存活，没有记录。本病例也没有记录生命体征、骤停时的心律和抢救时长、化验数值、溶栓药物与剂量、IABP 的指征，以及由谁、因何决定停止抢救。
text.en: Recorded course: a 66-year-old woman, already in hospital, developed chest tightness suddenly about an hour earlier, quickly stopped responding and had a cardiac and respiratory arrest; she was resuscitated with four shocks but remained unconscious. At the onset she was pale, cyanosed and sweating heavily. Examination: cold, cyanosed limbs; both pupils dilated with no light reaction; the apex beat on the right with faint heart sounds; weak spontaneous breathing with reduced breath sounds, wheeze and crackles in both lungs. Emergency ECG: paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, ventricular tachycardia and ST elevation in the anterior leads. Chest film: mirror-image dextrocardia with an enlarged cardiac silhouette; echocardiography and CT were not completed, so the detailed cardiac anatomy remained uncertain. Coronary angiography: left main stenosis 70 %, diffuse LAD disease up to 85 % with TIMI 3 flow, and complete occlusion of the proximal RCA with local thrombus. Treatment: thrombolysis first, then stenting of the RCA and an intra-aortic balloon pump (IABP); whether the angiogram was taken before or after the thrombolysis is not recorded. After the procedure the ST elevation fell, but she became anuric, with worsening acidosis and disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC). Further resuscitation was then stopped, and she left hospital about 10 hours after PCI; what happened afterwards, including whether she survived, is not recorded. This case also records no vital signs, no arrest rhythm or duration of resuscitation, no laboratory values, no lytic drug or dose, no indication for the IABP, and not who decided to stop resuscitation or why.

dose.zh-CN: 普通肝素 70–100 U/kg 静脉推注（计划用糖蛋白 IIb/IIIa 受体拮抗剂时 50–70 U/kg），术中按活化凝血时间追加。
dose.en: Unfractionated heparin 70–100 U/kg IV bolus (50–70 U/kg if a glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitor is planned), with further doses during the procedure guided by the activated clotting time.

response.zh-CN: 肝素已推注。本病例没有记录是否用过肝素；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Heparin given. This case does not record whether heparin was given; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 启动心导管室（急诊冠状动脉造影）
name.en: Activate the catheter laboratory (emergency coronary angiography)

dose.zh-CN: 一个电话启动：呼叫介入心内科医生和导管室团队，准备立即行冠状动脉造影并按需 PCI，同时交代你已掌握的情况。
dose.en: Single-call activation: page the interventional cardiologist and the catheter-laboratory team for immediate coronary angiography and PCI as needed, and hand over what you have found.

response.zh-CN: 介入团队已接到呼叫，导管室正在准备。本病例没有记录从心电图到造影用了多长时间；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: The interventional team has been called and the laboratory is being prepared. This case does not record how long it took from the ECG to the angiogram; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 胺碘酮静脉用药（室性心动过速反复时）

dose.zh-CN: 胺碘酮 300 mg 用 5% 葡萄糖稀释，10–20 分钟静脉输注，继以 900 mg 维持 24 小时；同时纠正血钾、血镁；室速伴血流动力学不稳定时先行同步电复律。
dose.en: Amiodarone 300 mg in 5 % glucose IV over 10–20 minutes, then 900 mg over 24 hours, correcting potassium and magnesium alongside; if VT recurs with haemodynamic instability, synchronised cardioversion comes first.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录任何抗心律失常药物，不模拟其效果；开通闭塞血管、去除缺血诱因，同样是防止室性心律失常复发的关键。
response.en: This case records no antiarrhythmic drug and does not simulate one; opening the occluded artery to remove the ischaemic trigger is just as much part of preventing recurrent ventricular arrhythmia.

name.zh-CN: 静脉溶栓

dose.zh-CN: 替奈普酶按体重分档单次静脉推注（< 60 kg 30 mg，至 ≥ 90 kg 50 mg），或阿替普酶按体重给药。
dose.en: Tenecteplase as a single weight-banded IV bolus (30 mg below 60 kg, up to 50 mg at 90 kg or more), or weight-adjusted alteplase.

harm.zh-CN: 本院有心导管室：能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成直接 PCI 时，直接 PCI 优于溶栓（ESC 2023 ACS）。为等待导管室而先给全量溶栓、随后立即 PCI，在 ASSENT-4 PCI 试验（2006）中增加了死亡、心力衰竭或休克的复合事件和卒中。她刚经历心肺复苏和多次电击，抢救时长、出血史、手术史和卒中史都不清楚，溶栓只会增加出血风险。
harm.en: This hospital has a catheter laboratory: where primary PCI can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis it is preferred to fibrinolysis (ESC 2023 ACS). Full-dose lysis given while waiting for an immediate PCI increased the combined rate of death, heart failure or shock, and of strokes, in the ASSENT-4 PCI trial (2006). She has just had CPR with repeated shocks, and the length of her resuscitation and her bleeding, surgical and stroke history are unknown — lysis only adds bleeding risk.

response.zh-CN: 溶栓药已给。本病例记录她接受过溶栓，但没有记录药名、剂量、时机和选择溶栓的原因；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The lytic has been given. This case records that she received thrombolysis, but not the drug, dose or timing, or why it was chosen; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 先收入重症监护室，等她醒来或神经预后明确后再决定造影
name.en: Admit to intensive care and decide on angiography once she wakes or her neurological outlook is clear

dose.zh-CN: 收入重症监护室行复苏后治疗，暂不造影；待她清醒或神经预后明确后再评估冠状动脉。
dose.en: Admit to intensive care for post-arrest treatment without angiography for now; assess the coronary arteries once she is awake or her neurological outlook is clear.

harm.zh-CN: 复苏后心电图仍有 ST 段抬高时，ESC 2023 ACS 推荐直接 PCI 策略；昏迷要纳入获益与风险的权衡，但早期昏迷不能证明治疗徒劳——神经预后要到复苏后至少 72 小时才能可靠评估（ERC–ESICM 2025），等到那时，闭塞的血管早已错过开通的时机。
harm.en: With ST elevation on the ECG after resuscitation, ESC 2023 ACS recommends a primary PCI strategy; her coma enters the benefit–risk judgement, but an early coma cannot establish futility — the neurological outlook cannot be judged reliably until at least 72 hours after ROSC (ERC–ESICM 2025), long after an occluded artery should have been opened.

response.zh-CN: 已安排收入重症监护室。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Admission arranged. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 因双侧瞳孔散大固定，与家属商定停止积极治疗
name.en: Agree with the family to stop active treatment because of the fixed, dilated pupils

dose.zh-CN: 以复苏后瞳孔散大、对光反射消失为依据，与家属谈话并停止积极治疗。
dose.en: On the grounds of the dilated, unreactive pupils after resuscitation, talk with the family and stop active treatment.

harm.zh-CN: 心脏骤停后最初数小时的瞳孔散大、对光反射消失可由缺氧、抢救用药和低灌注造成，不能可靠预测脑功能结局；ERC–ESICM 2025 要求在复苏后至少 72 小时、排除镇静等干扰后再进行多模式预后评估。据此过早限制治疗，会让“预后不良”变成自我实现的预言，并放弃治疗一个可能仍可逆的病因。
harm.en: Dilated pupils without a light reaction in the first hours after a cardiac arrest can follow hypoxia, resuscitation drugs and low perfusion, and do not reliably predict brain outcome; ERC–ESICM 2025 calls for multimodal assessment no earlier than 72 hours after ROSC, once sedation and other confounders are excluded. Limiting treatment on them now makes a 'poor prognosis' self-fulfilling and abandons treatment of a cause that may still be reversible.

response.zh-CN: 已与家属谈话。本病例不模拟这一选择的后果。
response.en: The conversation has taken place. This case does not simulate the consequences of this choice.

name.zh-CN: 对闭塞的罪犯血管行 PCI 并置入支架
name.en: PCI with stenting of the occluded culprit artery

dose.zh-CN: 由介入团队开通罪犯病变，处理血栓并置入支架。
dose.en: The interventional team opens the culprit lesion, deals with the thrombus and places a stent.

response.zh-CN: 罪犯血管已开通并置入支架。本病例不模拟其效果；记录中团队的做法见记录的结局。
response.en: The culprit artery has been opened and stented. This case does not simulate the effect; what the recorded team did is shown in the outcome record.

name.zh-CN: 同一次手术中完成所有严重病变的 PCI（多支血管同期介入）
name.en: PCI of every severe lesion in the same procedure (multivessel PCI in one sitting)

dose.zh-CN: 开通罪犯血管后，在同一次手术中继续处理其他所有严重狭窄。
dose.en: After opening the culprit, go on to treat every other severe stenosis in the same procedure.

harm.zh-CN: 她刚复苏、仍昏迷，四肢冰冷发绀，血压没有记录，不能按病情稳定处理，也不能排除休克：对心源性休克，ESC 2023 ACS 推荐首次手术仅处理罪犯血管（CULPRIT-SHOCK 试验，2017；该试验中同期多支血管 PCI 使 30 天死亡或需要肾脏替代治疗的比例更高）。完全血运重建（首次 PCI 时或 45 天内完成）适用于稳定的患者；左主干狭窄 70% 合并前降支弥漫病变用 PCI 还是旁路手术，应在她稳定后由心脏团队决定。
harm.en: She has just been resuscitated, is comatose and has cold, cyanosed limbs with no recorded blood pressure, so she cannot be treated as stable and shock cannot be excluded: in cardiogenic shock ESC 2023 ACS recommends PCI of the culprit only at the index procedure (CULPRIT-SHOCK, 2017, in which immediate multivessel PCI raised death or renal replacement therapy at 30 days). Complete revascularisation — at the index PCI or within 45 days — is for stable patients, and how a 70 % left main with diffuse LAD disease is treated (PCI or bypass surgery) is a Heart Team decision once she is stable.

response.zh-CN: 所有严重病变已同期处理。本病例没有这样做的记录，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Every severe lesion has been treated in one sitting. This case has no record of this and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 主动脉内球囊反搏（IABP）

dose.zh-CN: 经股动脉置入主动脉内球囊，按心电或动脉压触发反搏。
dose.en: Intra-aortic balloon inserted through the femoral artery, triggered from the ECG or the arterial pressure.

response.zh-CN: IABP 已置入。本病例不模拟其效果；记录中团队是否使用见记录的结局。ESC 2023 ACS 不推荐在没有机械并发症的心源性休克中常规使用 IABP（IABP-SHOCK II 试验，2012）。
response.en: The IABP is in. This case does not simulate its effect; whether the recorded team used one is shown in the outcome record. ESC 2023 ACS advises against routine IABP in cardiogenic shock without a mechanical complication (IABP-SHOCK II, 2012).

name.zh-CN: 与重症团队讨论肾脏替代治疗
name.en: Discuss renal replacement therapy with the intensive care team

dose.zh-CN: 请重症医学科评估是否开始连续性肾脏替代治疗（指征包括难以纠正的酸中毒、高钾血症、液体过负荷或无尿），并结合已商定的治疗目标决定。
dose.en: Ask the intensive care team about continuous renal replacement therapy (indications include refractory acidosis, hyperkalaemia, fluid overload or anuria), decided in line with the agreed goals of care.

response.zh-CN: 已请重症团队评估。本病例没有记录是否做过肾脏替代治疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The intensive care team has been asked. This case does not record whether renal replacement therapy was used; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 与家属谈话：说明病情并共同商定治疗目标
name.en: Family meeting: explain the situation and agree the goals of care

dose.zh-CN: 在安静的房间与家属谈话（SPIKES）：先了解他们知道多少，说明现在能判断和还不能判断的事，询问她本人的意愿，商定下一步并约好再次沟通的时间。
dose.en: Meet the family in a quiet room (SPIKES): find out what they already know, explain what can and cannot yet be judged, ask what she herself would want, agree the next steps and a time to talk again.

response.zh-CN: 已与家属谈话。本病例没有记录与家属沟通的内容；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The meeting has taken place. This case does not record the conversations with her family; it does not simulate their effect.

title.zh-CN: 了解她发病前后的经过
title.en: Find out what happened before and after she stopped responding

hint.zh-CN: 只有家属能告诉你：哪些情况能帮你判断心跳为什么会停、抢救进行得怎样？
hint.en: Only her relative can tell you: what would help you judge why her heart stopped and how the resuscitation went?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁向家属了解：发生了什么、什么时候开始、之后怎样、在哪里和怎样抢救的，以及发作时她的样子。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask her relative what happened, when it began, what followed, where and how she was resuscitated, and how she looked at the time.

title.zh-CN: 复苏后床旁评估，定下首要处置
title.en: Assess her after the resuscitation and set the first priorities

hint.zh-CN: 按 ABCDE 走一遍：她能自己保护气道吗？呼吸够不够？循环怎样？此刻的瞳孔能告诉你什么，又不能告诉你什么？
hint.en: Work through ABCDE: can she protect her airway, is her breathing enough, how is her circulation — and what can her pupils tell you at this stage, and what can they not?

guidance.zh-CN: 检查她的意识、呼吸、双肺、瞳孔、手脚末梢、心尖搏动和心音，然后到会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Check her consciousness, breathing, lungs, pupils, hands and feet, apex beat and heart sounds, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 读懂心电图，决定下一步并付诸行动
title.en: Read the ECG, decide what comes next and act on it

hint.zh-CN: 这份心电图和你摸到的心尖搏动对得上吗？要弄清问题到底出在哪里，还需要什么？她昏迷不醒，这会改变你接下来的决定吗？
hint.en: Does this tracing fit the apex beat you felt? What more would show where the problem really lies — and does her coma change what you do next?

guidance.zh-CN: 推来心电图机记录 12 导联心电图并在床旁阅读，作答决策 2 和决策 3；然后付诸行动——打电话或下医嘱，启动你选择的方案。行动之后，病例进入下一阶段。
guidance.en: Bring the ECG machine, record and read a 12-lead ECG at the bedside, answer decisions 2 and 3, then act — make the call or the order that starts the plan you chose. The case moves on once you have acted.

title.zh-CN: 阅读造影，决定这次手术处理什么
title.en: Read the angiogram and decide what this procedure should treat

hint.zh-CN: 哪一处病变能解释这次骤停，你凭什么判断？这次急诊手术应该做到哪一步为止？
hint.en: Which lesion explains this arrest, and how do you tell? Where should this emergency procedure stop?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁调阅心导管室的造影记录，作答决策 4，然后让介入团队按你的决定施行手术。
guidance.en: Read the catheter laboratory's angiogram report at the bedside, answer decision 4, then have the interventional team carry out the procedure you chose.

title.zh-CN: 术后再评估，并与家属谈话
title.en: Reassess her after the procedure and talk with her family

hint.zh-CN: 血管开通以后，出现了哪些新问题？哪些现在就能判断，哪些还要等？家属最需要从你这里听到什么？
hint.en: With the artery open, what new problems have appeared? Which can be judged now and which must wait — and what does her family most need to hear from you?

guidance.zh-CN: 复查心电图，调阅血气和凝血结果，查看尿量，作答决策 5，再与家属谈话。
guidance.en: Repeat the ECG, read the blood gas and clotting results, check her urine output, answer decision 5, then meet her family.

title.en: Compare your plan with the recorded outcome

hint.zh-CN: 她的结局里，哪些是 PCI 能改变的，哪些不是？哪些关键事实始终不知道？
hint.en: In her outcome, what could the PCI change and what could it not — and which key facts were never recorded?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端或床旁调阅记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Read the recorded course and outcome at a records terminal or at the bedside.

prompt.zh-CN: 她住院期间胸闷后很快呼之不应、心跳呼吸骤停，经抢救和 4 次电击后仍呼之不应。现在：意识不清，自主呼吸微弱，双肺呼吸音低伴干、湿啰音，双侧瞳孔散大、对光反射消失，四肢冰冷发绀。接下来几分钟里你先做什么？
prompt.en: An inpatient, she stopped responding soon after chest tightness, had a cardiac and respiratory arrest and is still unresponsive after resuscitation with four shocks. Now she is unconscious and breathing only weakly, with reduced breath sounds, wheeze and crackles in both lungs, both pupils dilated without a light reaction, and cold, cyanosed limbs. What do you do first, in the next few minutes?

need.zh-CN: 先向家属问清骤停和抢救的经过，并检查她的意识、呼吸、双肺、瞳孔和四肢。
need.en: First ask her relative about the arrest and the resuscitation, and examine her consciousness, breathing, lungs, pupils and limbs.

text.zh-CN: 确保气道、控制通气（SpO₂ 94%–98%，PaCO₂ 正常），平均动脉压 > 60–65 mmHg，贴除颤电极，立即做 12 导联心电图
text.en: Secure the airway (intubate or confirm an existing tube), ventilate to SpO₂ 94–98 % and a normal PaCO₂, keep the mean pressure above 60–65 mmHg, apply pads and record a 12-lead ECG now

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。昏迷且呼吸微弱的复苏后患者需要确切的气道和受控通气；ERC–ESICM 2025 复苏后治疗指南建议避免低氧和高氧（SpO₂ 94%–98%）、维持正常 PaCO₂、避免低血压，并尽早记录 12 导联心电图寻找冠状动脉原因。她发病前胸闷、骤停时需要电击，心电图是下一项决定性检查；心律可能再次恶化，所以先贴好除颤电极。
feedback.en: Correct. A comatose, weakly breathing patient after ROSC needs a definitive airway and controlled ventilation; the ERC–ESICM 2025 post-resuscitation guideline advises avoiding both hypoxaemia and hyperoxaemia (SpO₂ 94–98 %), keeping the PaCO₂ normal, avoiding hypotension and recording a 12-lead ECG early to look for a coronary cause. She had chest tightness before the arrest and needed shocks, so the ECG is the next decisive test, and the pads go on first because the rhythm may deteriorate again.

text.zh-CN: 双侧瞳孔散大固定提示严重缺氧性脑损伤、预后极差：先与家属谈是否停止积极治疗，暂缓其他检查和有创操作，以免徒增她的痛苦
text.en: Fixed, dilated pupils point to severe hypoxic brain injury: talk with the family about stopping active treatment first, and hold other tests and invasive procedures so as not to add to her suffering

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。复苏后最初数小时的瞳孔散大、对光反射消失可由缺氧、抢救用药和低灌注造成，不能可靠预测结局；ERC–ESICM 2025 把多模式预后评估放在复苏后至少 72 小时、排除镇静等干扰之后。现在据此限制治疗，会让不良预后变成自我实现的预言。
feedback.en: No. Dilated, unreactive pupils in the first hours after ROSC can follow hypoxia, resuscitation drugs and low perfusion, and do not reliably predict outcome; ERC–ESICM 2025 places multimodal prognostication no earlier than 72 hours after ROSC, once sedation and other confounders are excluded. Limiting treatment on them now makes a poor prognosis self-fulfilling.

text.zh-CN: 面罩高流量吸氧 15 L/min，观察自主呼吸能否恢复，暂不插管以免诱发再次骤停；等循环稳定、她醒来后再记录心电图和做其他检查
text.en: Give high-flow oxygen by mask and see whether her breathing recovers, holding off intubation in case it triggers another arrest; record the ECG and other tests once she settles and wakes

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。意识不清、呼吸微弱的患者不能保护气道，面罩吸氧既不能保证通气，也不能防止误吸；ERC–ESICM 2025 把确切气道和受控通气列为仍昏迷患者复苏后处理的第一步。等她醒来再做心电图，可能错过需要立即再灌注的冠状动脉闭塞。
feedback.en: No. An unconscious patient with weak breathing cannot protect her airway, and a mask neither secures ventilation nor prevents aspiration; ERC–ESICM 2025 puts a secured airway and controlled ventilation first in the care of patients who remain comatose after ROSC. Waiting for her to wake before an ECG risks missing a coronary occlusion that needs reperfusion now.

text.zh-CN: 先送头颅 CT 查明昏迷和瞳孔改变的原因（例如脑出血或大面积脑梗死），再根据结果决定是否需要心电图、造影等心脏方面的检查
text.en: Send her for a CT head first to explain the coma and the pupils (a brain haemorrhage, say), and let the result decide whether cardiac tests such as an ECG or angiography are needed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。发病前胸闷、骤停时需要反复电击，首先要找的是冠状动脉原因，而心电图几分钟就能完成；先送 CT 会让一个刚复苏、气道未确保的患者离开抢救单元，推迟可能的再灌注。ERC–ESICM 2025 只在骤停前的表现提示非冠状动脉原因时先做 CT——她骤停前的胸闷指向心脏——心电图有明确 ST 段抬高时则优先造影。
feedback.en: No. Chest tightness before the arrest and the need for repeated shocks put a coronary cause first, and an ECG takes minutes; sending her to CT moves a newly resuscitated patient with an unsecured airway out of the resuscitation area and delays any reperfusion. ERC–ESICM 2025 puts CT first only when the features before the arrest suggest a non-coronary cause — hers, chest tightness, point to the heart — and prioritises angiography once the ECG shows clear ST elevation.

text.zh-CN: 插管后用纯氧持续通气并适度过度通气，把 PaCO₂ 降到 30 mmHg 左右以减轻脑水肿、保护大脑，等血压稳定后再记录心电图
text.en: Intubate, then ventilate with 100 % oxygen and mild hyperventilation to bring the PaCO₂ down to about 30 mmHg and limit brain swelling, recording the ECG once her pressure is stable

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。高氧和低碳酸血症都会伤害缺氧后的大脑：过度通气使脑血管收缩、减少脑血流。ERC–ESICM 2025 的目标是 SpO₂ 94%–98%、PaCO₂ 正常（约 35–45 mmHg），心电图也不应排在后面。
feedback.en: No. Hyperoxaemia and hypocapnia both harm the post-anoxic brain — hyperventilation constricts the cerebral vessels and cuts cerebral blood flow. ERC–ESICM 2025 targets SpO₂ 94–98 % and a normal PaCO₂ (about 35–45 mmHg), and the ECG should not wait.

prompt.zh-CN: 她的急诊心电图：阵发性心房颤动、室性心动过速，前壁导联 ST 段抬高。查体：心尖搏动在右侧，心音低弱。发病是从胸闷开始的。你的工作诊断是什么？
prompt.en: Her emergency ECG shows paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, ventricular tachycardia and ST elevation in the anterior leads. On examination the apex beat is on the right and the heart sounds are faint. The illness began with chest tightness. What is your working diagnosis?

need.zh-CN: 先问清起病经过，记录并阅读心电图，并触诊心尖搏动、听诊心音。
need.en: First establish how it began, record and read the ECG, and feel the apex beat and listen to the heart.

text.zh-CN: 急性 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死导致室性心律失常和心脏骤停；心尖搏动在右侧提示右位心，按标准导联判断的梗死部位还不可靠
text.en: An acute STEMI causing ventricular arrhythmia and the arrest; the right-sided apex beat suggests dextrocardia, so the territory read from standard leads is not yet reliable

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。发病前胸闷、骤停时需要电击、复苏后心电图 ST 段抬高并有室速，应按 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死处理（ESC 2023 ACS）。心尖搏动在右侧是体征：电极接错能改变心电图，却不能把心尖移到右边；镜像右位心时标准胸导联位于心脏的对侧，按导联名称推断梗死部位并不可靠。
feedback.en: Correct. Chest tightness, an arrest needing shocks and ST elevation with VT after ROSC are managed as STEMI (ESC 2023 ACS). A right-sided apex beat is a physical sign: misplaced electrodes can change an ECG but cannot move the apex, and with mirror-image anatomy the standard chest electrodes lie on the far side of the heart, so localising the infarct from the lead names is unreliable.

text.zh-CN: ST 段抬高和室速都是 4 次电击和心肺复苏造成的心肌挫伤和电击后改变，并没有急性冠状动脉闭塞，复查心电图会自行恢复
text.en: The ST elevation and VT are the after-effects of four shocks and CPR — bruised myocardium and post-shock change — with no acute coronary occlusion, and a repeat ECG will settle by itself

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。电击后可以出现短暂的 ST 段改变，但她骤停前就有胸闷，复苏后 ST 段抬高伴室速首先要考虑急性冠状动脉闭塞；ESC 2023 ACS 对复苏后心电图持续 ST 段抬高者推荐直接 PCI 策略。复查心电图可以做，但应与再灌注的准备同时进行，而不是作为排除诊断的理由。
feedback.en: No. Shocks can cause transient ST change, but she had chest tightness before the arrest, and ST elevation with VT after ROSC means acute coronary occlusion until proved otherwise; ESC 2023 ACS recommends a primary PCI strategy when the ST elevation persists after resuscitation. A repeat ECG can run alongside reperfusion planning, not serve as a reason to dismiss it.

text.zh-CN: 原发的颅内事件（如蛛网膜下腔出血）导致昏迷、瞳孔散大和骤停，心电图上的 ST 段抬高和心律失常都是继发的神经源性改变
text.en: A primary brain event such as a subarachnoid haemorrhage, causing the coma, the dilated pupils and the arrest, with the ST elevation and arrhythmia as secondary neurogenic changes

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。蛛网膜下腔出血确实可引起 ST 段改变和心律失常，但她是先胸闷、后呼之不应，骤停时需要电击；复苏后早期的瞳孔改变也不能定位病因。ERC–ESICM 2025 在心电图有明确 ST 段抬高时优先冠状动脉造影，只有骤停前的表现提示非冠状动脉原因时才先做 CT。
feedback.en: No. A subarachnoid haemorrhage can cause ST change and arrhythmia, but she had chest tightness first, then stopped responding and needed shocks, and pupils early after ROSC do not localise the cause. ERC–ESICM 2025 prioritises coronary angiography when the ECG shows clear ST elevation, and puts CT first only when the features before the arrest suggest a non-coronary cause.

text.zh-CN: 心肺复苏后的心包填塞：心音低弱、四肢冰冷发绀提示心脏受压，ST 段改变是心包积血刺激所致，而不是心肌梗死
text.en: Cardiac tamponade after CPR: faint heart sounds and cold, cyanosed limbs point to a compressed heart, and the ST change reflects blood in the pericardium rather than infarction

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。心包填塞应当用床旁超声排除，但它解释不了骤停前的胸闷和 ST 段抬高；心尖在右侧时，在常规左胸位置听到的心音本来就会偏弱。本病例没有完成超声心动图，所以填塞既无法确证也无法排除——这是本例结构资料的真实缺口（ESC 2023 ACS 建议对血流动力学不稳定或疑有机械并发症的患者行急诊超声心动图，但不应因此推迟导管室）。
feedback.en: No. Tamponade should be excluded with bedside ultrasound, but it does not explain the chest tightness before the arrest or the ST elevation, and with the apex on the right, heart sounds heard at the usual left-sided sites would be faint anyway. Echocardiography was not completed in this case, so tamponade can be neither confirmed nor excluded — a real gap in the structural evidence (ESC 2023 ACS recommends emergency echocardiography for haemodynamic instability or a suspected mechanical complication, without delaying the catheter laboratory).

text.zh-CN: 前壁心肌梗死，罪犯血管是前降支：前壁导联 ST 段抬高就足以定位，心尖搏动在右侧只是查体误差，不影响判断
text.en: An anterior infarction from the LAD: ST elevation in the anterior leads is enough to localise it, and a right-sided apex beat is an examination error that changes nothing

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。心尖搏动是查体所见，说明心脏本身位于右侧；镜像右位心时标准胸导联放在心脏的对侧，“前壁导联”的 ST 段抬高不能直接对应前降支。部位要靠镜像导联心电图和造影来确定；按 ESC 2023 ACS，再灌注的决定并不等待定位。
feedback.en: No. The apex beat is a physical sign that the heart itself lies on the right; in mirror-image dextrocardia the standard chest electrodes sit over the far side of the heart, so 'anterior' ST elevation cannot be mapped straight to the LAD. A mirror-image ECG and the angiogram settle the territory, and under ESC 2023 ACS the decision to reperfuse does not wait for it.

prompt.zh-CN: 你判断这是急性 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死导致的心脏骤停，她的心脏很可能在右侧，人仍昏迷。本院设有心导管室，介入团队随时可以呼叫。现在的再灌注方案是什么？
prompt.en: You have judged this an acute STEMI that caused her arrest, probably in a heart on the right, and she remains comatose. This hospital has a catheter laboratory, and the interventional team can be called at any hour. What is your reperfusion plan now?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 2，给出你的工作诊断。
need.en: First commit to a working diagnosis (decision 2).

text.zh-CN: 立即启动导管室行急诊造影和直接 PCI，给阿司匹林和术中肝素；加做镜像导联心电图、告知团队右位心，但都不拖延
text.en: Activate the catheter laboratory now for angiography and primary PCI, with aspirin and heparin; add a mirror-image ECG and warn the team about her anatomy, letting neither delay her

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ESC 2023 ACS 对复苏后心电图持续 ST 段抬高的患者推荐直接 PCI 策略，并把神经系统状况放在“是否徒劳”的权衡里——而在这么早的时候，她的昏迷和瞳孔都不能证明治疗徒劳；能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成 PCI 时，直接 PCI 优于溶栓；阿司匹林负荷（静脉 75–250 mg 或经胃管 150–300 mg），PCI 时普通肝素 70–100 U/kg（给药前先向家属问过抗凝药、过敏和近期出血）。镜像导联心电图和提前告知解剖异常有助于定位和操作，但都不应拖住导管室。
feedback.en: Correct. ESC 2023 ACS recommends a primary PCI strategy for persistent ST elevation after resuscitated cardiac arrest, weighing neurological status against futility — and this early, her coma and pupils cannot show futility; primary PCI is preferred to fibrinolysis when it can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis, with an aspirin load (75–250 mg IV, or 150–300 mg by nasogastric tube) and unfractionated heparin 70–100 U/kg at PCI, once her relative has been asked about anticoagulants, allergy and recent bleeding. The mirror-image ECG and the warning about her anatomy help localisation and the procedure, but neither should hold up the laboratory.

text.zh-CN: 立即静脉溶栓——溶栓药几分钟就能推完，比等导管室团队集结更快开通血管——随后把她送去造影，必要时再补做 PCI
text.en: Give fibrinolysis now — a lytic goes in within minutes, far sooner than the catheter team can assemble — then send her for angiography, with PCI if the artery is still closed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对——尽管记录中的团队确实先给了溶栓。溶栓只用于预计不能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成直接 PCI 的情况（ESC 2023 ACS）；为等待导管室而先给全量溶栓、随后立即 PCI，在 ASSENT-4 PCI 试验（2006）中增加了不良事件和卒中。她刚经历心肺复苏和多次电击，抢救时长和出血史都不清楚，出血风险更高。
feedback.en: No — though the recorded team did give thrombolysis first. Fibrinolysis is for when primary PCI cannot be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis (ESC 2023 ACS); full-dose lysis given while waiting for an immediate PCI increased adverse events and strokes in ASSENT-4 PCI (2006). After CPR with repeated shocks, with the length of her resuscitation and her bleeding history unknown, her bleeding risk is higher still.

text.zh-CN: 先收入 ICU 做复苏后治疗和体温管理，等她醒来、神经预后明确后再决定是否造影，免得对脑损伤严重的患者做无益的介入
text.en: Admit her to intensive care for post-arrest care and temperature control, and decide on angiography once she wakes and her outlook is clear, sparing a badly brain-injured patient a futile procedure

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ESC 2023 ACS 对复苏后持续 ST 段抬高者推荐直接 PCI 策略，并在获益与风险的权衡中考虑神经系统状况，但早期昏迷不能证明治疗徒劳：神经预后要到复苏后至少 72 小时才能可靠评估（ERC–ESICM 2025）。等到那时再造影，闭塞血管早已错过挽救心肌的时机，持续缺血还可能再诱发室性心律失常。
feedback.en: No. ESC 2023 ACS recommends a primary PCI strategy for persistent ST elevation after resuscitation and weighs neurological status in the benefit–risk judgement, but an early coma cannot show futility: the neurological outlook cannot be judged reliably until at least 72 hours after ROSC (ERC–ESICM 2025). By then the occluded artery has long passed the point of saving muscle, and ongoing ischaemia can trigger further ventricular arrhythmia.

text.zh-CN: 先做超声心动图和心脏 CT，弄清镜像解剖、冠状动脉起源和有无心包积液，再安排造影，让介入团队事先知道导管怎么走
text.en: Define the mirror-image anatomy, the coronary origins and any pericardial effusion with echocardiography and a cardiac CT first, then arrange angiography so the team knows how to steer the catheters

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。弄清解剖很有价值，但不能排在再灌注之前：造影本身就能显示冠状动脉的起源和走行，有经验的术者会在术中调整体位和导管。本病例中超声心动图和 CT 都没有完成；对复苏后 ST 段抬高的患者，ESC 2023 ACS 要求的是尽快直接 PCI，而不是先做结构检查。
feedback.en: No. Knowing the anatomy is valuable, but not before reperfusion: angiography itself shows the coronary origins and course, and an experienced operator adapts the projections and catheters during the procedure. In this case echocardiography and CT were never completed; for ST elevation after resuscitation ESC 2023 ACS asks for prompt primary PCI, not structural imaging first.

text.zh-CN: 先抽血查高敏肌钙蛋白，1 小时后复查 12 导联心电图：电击后的 ST 段改变可能是暂时的，两项都异常再启动导管室
text.en: Send a high-sensitivity troponin and repeat the 12-lead ECG in an hour — ST change after shocks can be transient — and activate the catheter laboratory only if both are abnormal

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。疑似 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死时，肌钙蛋白不能决定是否再灌注（ESC 2023 ACS）。电击后确有出现短暂改变的可能，但她骤停前就有胸闷、复苏后又有室速，复查心电图应与启动导管室同时进行，而不是作为启动的前提。
feedback.en: No. In suspected STEMI, troponin does not decide reperfusion (ESC 2023 ACS). Post-shock change is possible, but she had chest tightness before the arrest and VT afterwards, so a repeat ECG runs alongside activation, not as its precondition.

prompt.zh-CN: 造影：左主干狭窄 70%；前降支弥漫性病变，最重处狭窄 85%，TIMI 3 级血流；右冠状动脉近段完全闭塞，局部有血栓。这次急诊手术应该怎么做？
prompt.en: The angiogram shows left main stenosis 70 %; diffuse LAD disease, worst 85 %, with TIMI 3 flow; and complete occlusion of the proximal right coronary artery with local thrombus. What should this emergency procedure do?

need.zh-CN: 先在本阶段调阅心导管室的造影记录。
need.en: First read the catheter laboratory's angiogram report in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 把有血栓的右冠状动脉近段完全闭塞视为罪犯病变，现在开通并置入支架；左主干和前降支病变留待她稳定后由心脏团队决定
text.en: Treat the thrombotic occlusion of the proximal RCA as the culprit and open and stent it now; leave the left main and LAD disease for a Heart Team decision once she is stable

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。罪犯病变是完全闭塞并有血栓的血管，而不是狭窄最重或导联名称所指的那支；前降支仍有 TIMI 3 级血流。她刚经历骤停、仍昏迷，四肢冰冷发绀，血压没有记录，不能算血流动力学稳定，也不能排除心源性休克：对心源性休克，ESC 2023 ACS 推荐首次手术只做罪犯血管 PCI（CULPRIT-SHOCK 试验，2017），完全血运重建（首次 PCI 时或 45 天内完成）则适用于稳定的患者——所以左主干和前降支病变由心脏团队在她稳定后决定。记录中的团队也对右冠状动脉置入了支架。
feedback.en: Correct. The culprit is the vessel completely occluded with thrombus, not the tightest narrowing or the one the lead names suggest — the LAD still has TIMI 3 flow. Just after an arrest, comatose, with cold, cyanosed limbs and no recorded blood pressure, she cannot be counted as haemodynamically stable and shock cannot be excluded: in cardiogenic shock ESC 2023 ACS recommends PCI of the culprit only at the index procedure (CULPRIT-SHOCK, 2017), while complete revascularisation (at the index PCI or within 45 days) is for stable patients — so the left main and LAD go to a Heart Team once she is stable. The recorded team stented the RCA as well.

text.zh-CN: 罪犯血管是前降支：ST 段抬高在前壁导联，应先处理它最重的 85% 狭窄；右冠状动脉闭塞可能是陈旧病变，以后再说
text.en: The culprit is the LAD, because the ST elevation was in the anterior leads: treat its 85 % stenosis first, and leave the RCA occlusion, which may be old, for later

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。镜像右位心时“前壁导联”不能直接对应前降支，而造影显示前降支仍有 TIMI 3 级血流，并未闭塞；完全闭塞并有局部血栓的右冠状动脉近段才是罪犯病变。处理非罪犯血管、却让闭塞的血管继续闭着，正是轻信导联名称的代价（ESC 2023 ACS：直接 PCI 先处理罪犯血管）。
feedback.en: No. In mirror-image dextrocardia the 'anterior' leads do not map onto the LAD, and the angiogram shows TIMI 3 flow in the LAD — it is not occluded; the proximal RCA, completely occluded with local thrombus, is the culprit. Treating a non-culprit vessel while the occlusion stays closed is the price of trusting the lead names (ESC 2023 ACS: primary PCI treats the culprit first).

text.zh-CN: 一次完成全部血运重建：先开通右冠状动脉，再同期处理左主干和前降支，让她离开导管室时所有严重病变都已处理
text.en: Complete revascularisation in one sitting: open the RCA, then treat the left main and LAD in the same procedure, so she leaves the laboratory with every severe lesion treated

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。对血流动力学稳定的患者，完全血运重建是可选的做法（ESC 2023 ACS：首次 PCI 时或 45 天内完成）；但她刚复苏、仍昏迷，四肢冰冷发绀，血压没有记录，不能排除休克——而在心源性休克中，同期处理非罪犯病变使 30 天死亡或需要肾脏替代治疗的比例更高（CULPRIT-SHOCK，2017）。左主干病变用 PCI 还是旁路手术，应由心脏团队在她稳定后决定。
feedback.en: No. Complete revascularisation is an option for a stable patient (ESC 2023 ACS: at the index PCI or within 45 days), but she has just been resuscitated, is comatose and has cold, cyanosed limbs with no recorded blood pressure, so shock cannot be excluded — and in shock, immediate PCI of the non-culprit lesions raised death or renal replacement therapy at 30 days (CULPRIT-SHOCK, 2017). Whether the left main is treated by PCI or bypass is a Heart Team decision once she is stable.

text.zh-CN: 左主干合并前降支弥漫病变属于外科范畴：不做 PCI，直接请心外科行急诊冠状动脉旁路移植术，一次解决全部病变
text.en: Left main and diffuse LAD disease are surgical: skip PCI and ask the cardiac surgeons for emergency bypass grafting to deal with every lesion at once

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。眼下的任务是尽快开通闭塞的罪犯血管，PCI 几分钟就能做到；急诊旁路手术用于 PCI 失败或不可行、或出现机械并发症时（ESC 2023 ACS）。对刚复苏、神经结局未知的患者，体外循环手术风险很高，左主干病变的长远方案可以之后由心脏团队决定。
feedback.en: No. The task now is to open the occluded culprit fast, which PCI can do within minutes; emergency bypass is for failed or unfeasible PCI or mechanical complications (ESC 2023 ACS). Cardiopulmonary bypass is high-risk in a newly resuscitated patient with an unknown neurological outcome, and the long-term plan for the left main can follow from a Heart Team.

text.zh-CN: 左主干狭窄 70% 使任何导管操作都风险太大：这次不做 PCI，以抗栓和药物治疗为主，等心脏团队讨论后再定
text.en: A 70 % left main stenosis makes any catheter work too dangerous: no PCI this time, antithrombotic and medical treatment, and a Heart Team discussion later

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。左主干狭窄 70%、前降支有 TIMI 3 级血流，并不妨碍对闭塞的右冠状动脉行 PCI；放着闭塞不开通，梗死会继续扩大，室性心律失常也可能反复。ESC 2023 ACS 对 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死首先要求开通罪犯血管。
feedback.en: No. A 70 % left main stenosis with TIMI 3 flow in the LAD does not stop PCI of the occluded RCA; leaving the occlusion closed lets the infarct grow and the ventricular arrhythmia return. ESC 2023 ACS puts opening the culprit artery first in STEMI.

prompt.zh-CN: 支架术后，心电图上的 ST 段抬高已经回落；但此后她出现无尿、酸中毒加重和 DIC。家属问你：“她还能醒过来吗？还要不要继续治？”你怎么回应、怎么安排？
prompt.en: After the stenting, the ST elevation on her ECG has fallen; but since then she has become anuric, with worsening acidosis and DIC. Her relative asks you: 'Will she wake up? Should all this go on?' How do you respond, and what do you arrange?

need.zh-CN: 先在本阶段复查心电图、调阅血气和凝血结果，并查看尿量。
need.en: First repeat the ECG, read the blood gas and clotting results and check her urine output in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 说明血管已通，但肾、凝血和酸碱在衰竭，商讨可能有益的支持（肾脏替代、出血时输血）；脑功能至少 72 小时后才能评估；按她的意愿定目标
text.en: Say the artery is open but her kidneys, clotting and acid balance are failing; offer support that may help (dialysis, blood products for bleeding); her brain cannot be judged before 72 hours; set goals by her wishes

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ST 段回落说明罪犯血管已开通，并不代表她在康复；无尿伴酸中毒加重是考虑肾脏替代治疗的指征（KDIGO 2012 AKI 指南），DIC 首先要治疗病因、出血时再补充血制品。脑功能预后要到复苏后至少 72 小时、排除镇静后多模式评估（ERC–ESICM 2025）；而因多器官衰竭限制治疗是另一个问题，现在就可以按她的意愿与家属商定。
feedback.en: Correct. A fall in ST elevation shows the culprit artery is open, not that she is recovering; anuria with worsening acidosis is an indication to consider renal replacement therapy (KDIGO 2012 AKI), and DIC is managed by treating its cause and giving blood products for bleeding. Brain prognosis waits for multimodal assessment at least 72 hours after ROSC, off sedation (ERC–ESICM 2025); limiting treatment because of multi-organ failure is a separate question that can be agreed now with the family, guided by her wishes.

text.zh-CN: 让家属放心：ST 段回落说明心肌梗死已经治好、她正在好转，无尿和凝血的问题会随着心功能恢复而自行好转，不必另作处理，也不必谈治疗目标
text.en: Reassure the family: the fall in ST elevation shows the infarct is treated and she is getting better, and the kidney and clotting problems will settle by themselves as her heart recovers, so goals need no discussion

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ST 段回落只说明罪犯血管已开通，不等于器官功能在恢复；无尿、酸中毒加重和 DIC 是新的、危及生命的问题，需要各自的评估和支持（KDIGO 2012 AKI 指南）。虚假的安慰会让家属在病情恶化时毫无准备。
feedback.en: No. The fall in ST elevation shows only that the culprit artery is open, not that her organs are recovering; anuria, worsening acidosis and DIC are new, life-threatening problems that need their own assessment and support (KDIGO 2012 AKI). False reassurance leaves the family unprepared if she deteriorates.

text.zh-CN: 告诉家属：复苏后双侧瞳孔散大固定早已说明她不会醒来，现在又加上多器官衰竭，各种支持治疗都没有意义，建议今晚就停止所有治疗
text.en: Tell the family that the fixed, dilated pupils after the arrest already showed she will not wake up, that with organ failure on top the present support is pointless, and that all of it should stop tonight

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。复苏后早期的瞳孔散大固定不能可靠预测结局；ERC–ESICM 2025 要求在复苏后至少 72 小时、排除镇静等干扰后进行多模式评估。如果要讨论限制治疗，理由应是如实说明的多器官衰竭和她本人的意愿，而不是早期的瞳孔。
feedback.en: No. Fixed, dilated pupils early after ROSC do not reliably predict outcome; ERC–ESICM 2025 requires multimodal assessment no earlier than 72 hours after ROSC, once sedation and other confounders are excluded. If limits on treatment are discussed, the reasons are her multi-organ failure, stated honestly, and her own wishes — not the early pupils.

text.zh-CN: 暂不和家属谈治疗目标：所有治疗照常继续，包括肾脏替代和输血，等复苏后 72 小时的神经功能评估有了结果再谈，免得家属过早失去希望
text.en: Hold any talk about goals for now: continue every treatment, dialysis and transfusion included, and wait for the neurological assessment at 72 hours after ROSC before discussing anything, so the family keeps hope

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。神经预后需要等待，沟通却不能等：家属现在就需要知道器官衰竭的严重性和不确定性，并参与决定肾脏替代治疗等是否符合她的意愿。ERC–ESICM 2025 只要求推迟神经预后判断，并没有要求推迟与家属的沟通；用 SPIKES 等框架分步说明，既不提前下结论，也不回避坏消息。
feedback.en: No. The neurological verdict must wait, but the conversation cannot: the family needs to hear now how serious and uncertain her organ failure is, and to help decide whether treatments such as renal replacement fit her wishes. ERC–ESICM 2025 delays the neurological verdict, not the conversation; a framework such as SPIKES explains step by step without a premature verdict or avoided bad news.

text.zh-CN: 把选择完全交给家属：如实列出继续抢救和停止抢救两种做法及各自的后果，请他们今晚自己决定，医生不给建议，以免影响他们
text.en: Leave the choice entirely to the family: set out continuing and stopping and what each would mean for her, ask them to decide by tonight, and give no medical recommendation so as not to sway them

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。共同决策不是把决定全部推给家属：医生要说明哪些治疗在医学上可行、可能达到什么，再结合她本人的意愿给出建议。按 ERC–ESICM 2025，此刻还不能给出脑功能预后，所以团队的建议只能建立在器官衰竭和她的意愿之上；让家属在没有专业意见时独自决定生死，会给他们留下长久的负担。
feedback.en: No. Shared decision-making does not hand the whole decision to the family: the team explains which treatments are medically feasible and what they could achieve, then recommends a course shaped by her wishes. Under ERC–ESICM 2025 no brain prognosis can be given yet, so the team's view rests on her organ failure and her wishes; asking relatives to decide alone, with no medical view, leaves them a lasting burden.

text.zh-CN: 向家属问清经过：先有胸闷、起病时间、随后的骤停、住院中抢救并电击 4 次，以及发作时的面色和出汗
text.en: Took the story from her relative: chest tightness first, when it began, the arrest that followed, resuscitation in hospital with four shocks, and how she looked at the time

text.zh-CN: 向家属询问长期用药（抗凝药）、药物和造影剂过敏、近期出血/手术/卒中，以及以前是否知道心脏位置异常
text.en: Asked her relative about regular medicines (anticoagulants), drug and contrast allergy, recent bleeding, surgery or stroke, and whether an abnormal heart position was already known

text.zh-CN: 复苏后完成床旁查体：意识、呼吸、双肺听诊、瞳孔、四肢末梢、心尖搏动和心音
text.en: Examined her after the resuscitation: consciousness, breathing, lung auscultation, pupils, peripheral perfusion, the apex beat and the heart sounds

text.zh-CN: 在抢救阶段记录并阅读 12 导联心电图，申请镜像导联心电图，并阅读床旁胸片
text.en: In the resuscitation phase, recorded and read a 12-lead ECG, asked for a mirror-image ECG and read the portable chest film

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即定下复苏后首要处置，并在抢救阶段确保气道、控制通气
text.en: Set the first post-resuscitation priorities at the first attempt and secured the airway with controlled ventilation in the resuscitation phase

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即认出右位心背景下的急性 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死，没有被电击后改变、颅内事件、心包填塞或导联名称误导
text.en: Recognised an acute STEMI in a heart that is probably on the right, at the first attempt, unswayed by post-shock change, a brain event, tamponade or the lead names

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即认定需要急诊冠状动脉造影，并在她离开抢救单元前呼叫了导管室
text.en: Committed to emergency coronary angiography at the first attempt and called the catheter laboratory before she left the resuscitation bay

text.zh-CN: 给予复苏后和 PCI 前后的基本处置：持续监护并贴除颤电极、阿司匹林、PCI 用普通肝素和体温管理
text.en: Gave the core post-arrest and peri-PCI care: monitoring with defibrillator pads, aspirin, heparin for PCI and temperature control

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把右冠状动脉的血栓性闭塞认定为罪犯病变，急诊手术只处理这一处
text.en: Identified the thrombotic RCA occlusion as the culprit at the first attempt and treated only that lesion in the emergency procedure

text.zh-CN: 没有因早期瞳孔改变限制治疗，也没有用溶栓或“等她醒来再造影”代替急诊 PCI
text.en: Did not limit treatment on the early pupils, nor replace emergency PCI with fibrinolysis or with angiography only once she wakes

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把现在能判断的器官衰竭与要等待的脑功能预后分开，并与家属进行了谈话
text.en: Separated the organ failure that can be judged now from the brain prognosis that must wait, at the first attempt, and held the family meeting

text.zh-CN: 用 SPIKES 框架与家属沟通她的病情、不确定性和治疗目标
text.en: Talked with her family about her condition, the uncertainty and the goals of care using SPIKES

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（SPIKES）：环境——安静的房间，请家属坐下，自我介绍，留出时间；认知——先问家属对骤停和手术已经知道多少；邀请——问他们想了解到多细；告知——用通俗的话、不用术语：她的心跳停了，是因为心脏的一根血管堵了，团队已经把它打通并放了支架，心电图也好转了，但之后她的肾脏不出尿了，血液变得更酸，凝血也出了问题；她的大脑能不能恢复，现在谁也说不准——至少要到心跳恢复 72 小时以后才能可靠判断，早先的瞳孔散大并不能下定论；情绪——体察家属的恐惧和悲伤，容许沉默，诚实回答“她还能醒吗”，既不给虚假的希望，也不提前宣判；策略与总结——询问她本人以前会怎么希望，说明哪些治疗（肾脏替代、血制品）可能还有帮助、它们做不到什么，给出团队的建议，商定下一步和再次沟通的时间。不编造病例中没有的结果、时间或结局，也不指责之前的处理。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (SPIKES): Setting — a quiet room, the relative seated, introductions, enough time; Perception — first asks what the family already knows about the arrest and the procedure; Invitation — asks how much detail they want; Knowledge — in plain words without jargon: her heart stopped because one of its arteries was blocked, the team has opened it and put in a stent and the heart tracing has improved, but since then her kidneys have stopped making urine, her blood has become more acidic and her clotting has gone wrong; nobody can yet say whether her brain will recover — that cannot be judged reliably until at least 72 hours after her heart restarted, and the wide pupils early on do not settle it; Emotions — acknowledges fear and grief, allows silence, answers 'Will she wake up?' honestly, without false hope or a premature verdict; Strategy and summary — asks what she would have wanted, explains which treatments (kidney support, blood products) could still help and what they cannot do, gives the team's recommendation, and agrees the next steps and a time to talk again. Invents no result, time or outcome the case does not record, and does not blame the earlier care.

name.zh-CN: 滕护士

knowledge.zh-CN: 交班（ISBAR）：现状——66岁女性，住院期间出现胸闷，很快呼之不应，随即心跳呼吸骤停；背景——经抢救、电击 4 次，她的既往情况床旁团队并不清楚；评估——仍呼之不应，自主呼吸微弱；建议——请医生立即评估。物资：抢救单元床旁有监护除颤仪、心电图机、气道车和呼吸机、抢救车（留置针、急救药品）和氧气；床旁 X 线机和超声仪可以推来；心导管室和介入医生一个电话就能呼叫；术后她将转入重症监护室，那里有床旁血液净化机。复述医嘱，完成护理范围内的操作；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到生命体征、化验数值或具体时间时，如实说没有可报的记录，绝不报出数字。
knowledge.en: Handover (ISBAR): Situation — a 66-year-old woman, already an inpatient, who developed chest tightness, quickly stopped responding and had a cardiac and respiratory arrest; Background — resuscitated with four shocks, and her past history is not known to the bedside team; Assessment — still unresponsive and breathing only weakly; Recommendation — needs a doctor's assessment now. Kit: in the resuscitation bay are the monitor-defibrillator, the ECG machine, the airway trolley and ventilator, the crash cart (cannulas, emergency drugs) and oxygen; the portable X-ray and the ultrasound machine can be brought; the catheter laboratory and the interventional cardiologist are reached with a single call; after the procedure she goes to intensive care, where the renal replacement machine is. Reads orders back and carries out nursing-scope tasks; reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for vital signs, laboratory values or times, says plainly there is nothing recorded to report — never gives a number.

name.zh-CN: 裴医生（急诊科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“一个呼吸微弱、叫不醒的复苏后患者，第一步该保证什么？”“此刻的瞳孔散大能说明什么、不能说明什么？什么时候才能可靠判断脑功能？”“心尖搏动在右边，你的心电图还能按导联名称读吗？电极接反和右位心怎么区分？”“她昏迷，这会改变要不要急诊造影吗？溶栓还是去导管室，为什么？”“造影上哪一处病变能解释这次骤停？急诊手术该在哪里停？”“血管开通了，为什么她的肾脏和凝血还在恶化？家属问‘她还能醒吗’，你怎么回答？”。可以讲解 ESC 2023 ACS、ERC–ESICM 2025 复苏后治疗和 ERC 2025 高级生命支持的相关原则；学员读到相应记录之后，可以对照记录的病程（先溶栓、后支架和 IABP，术后多器官衰竭、停止抢救并离院）与现行做法。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的资料（生命体征、骤停心律和抢救时长、心电图导联放置、化验数值、溶栓药物与剂量、IABP 指征、谁决定停止抢救，以及离院后的情况都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “In a weakly breathing patient who will not wake after an arrest, what do you secure first?”, “What can her dilated pupils tell you at this point, and what can they not — and when can the brain be judged?”, “With the apex beat on the right, can you read this ECG by its lead names? How do you tell swapped electrodes from dextrocardia?”, “Does her coma change whether she goes for emergency angiography? Lysis or the catheter laboratory — which, and why?”, “Which lesion on the angiogram explains the arrest, and where should the emergency procedure stop?”, “The artery is open — why are her kidneys and clotting still failing, and what do you say when her relative asks ‘Will she wake up?’”. May explain the relevant principles of ESC 2023 ACS, ERC–ESICM 2025 post-resuscitation care and ERC 2025 advanced life support, and — once the learner has read the records — contrast the recorded course (thrombolysis first, then a stent and an IABP; multi-organ failure; resuscitation stopped and her leaving hospital) with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (vital signs, the arrest rhythm and its duration, the ECG electrode placement, laboratory values, the lytic drug and dose, the reason for the IABP, who decided to stop resuscitation and what happened after she left are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 卢医生（心内科介入医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 介入心内科医生，接到导管室呼叫后参与。只解读学员已经读过的心电图、胸片和造影记录：标准导联下右位心心电图的一般特点（I 导联 P 波、QRS 波和 T 波倒置，aVR 直立，胸导联 R 波由 V1 到 V6 逐渐变小；她这份心电图有没有这些表现没有记录）以及与左右上肢电极接反的区别（接反时胸导联 R 波递增正常，而且电极不会改变心尖的位置）；镜像导联心电图怎样记录（左右上肢电极互换，胸导联移到右胸对称位置）；镜像解剖下造影体位和导管旋转方向要反过来；为什么有血栓的闭塞血管才是罪犯病变、对不稳定的患者急诊手术为什么只处理罪犯病变、为什么不常规使用 IABP（IABP-SHOCK II），以及左主干病变为什么要交给心脏团队。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造术后 TIMI 血流、支架数目和类型、左心室功能、IABP 的指征，或这次造影与溶栓的先后（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Interventional cardiologist who joins once the catheter laboratory is called. Interprets only the ECG, chest film and angiogram report the learner has read: the standard-lead ECG of dextrocardia in general (inverted P, QRS and T in lead I, an upright aVR, R waves shrinking from V1 to V6 — which of these her own tracing showed is not recorded) and how it differs from swapped arm electrodes (normal chest-lead R-wave progression, and no electrode moves the apex beat); how to record a mirror-image ECG (arm electrodes swapped, chest electrodes mirrored onto the right chest); why mirror-image anatomy reverses the angiographic projections and the catheter turns; why the occluded vessel with thrombus is the culprit, why in a patient who is not stable the emergency procedure treats only the culprit, why an IABP is not routine (IABP-SHOCK II), and why the left main goes to the Heart Team. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents post-PCI TIMI flow, stent number or type, left-ventricular function, the reason for the IABP, or whether this angiogram came before or after the thrombolysis (none is recorded).

name.zh-CN: 葛医生（重症医学科医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 重症医学科医生，术后在重症监护室参与。只解读学员已经读过的术后心电图、血气、凝血和肾功能结果：心脏骤停后综合征包括哪些部分；无尿伴酸中毒加重时肾脏替代治疗的指征和时机（KDIGO 2012 AKI 指南）；DIC 先治疗病因，出血或需要操作时再按化验补充血小板、血浆或纤维蛋白原；仍昏迷患者的体温管理（主动预防发热）；神经预后为什么要到复苏后至少 72 小时、排除镇静后多模式评估（ERC–ESICM 2025）；怎样把“器官衰竭能不能支持”与“大脑能不能恢复”分开，并和家属一起商定治疗目标。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造血气、血小板、凝血或肌酐的数值、尿量数字、血管活性药物或出血情况（都没有记录）；不提前透露记录的结局。
knowledge.en: Intensivist who joins in intensive care after the procedure. Interprets only the post-PCI ECG, blood gas, clotting and renal results the learner has read: what the post-cardiac-arrest syndrome comprises; when anuria with worsening acidosis calls for renal replacement therapy (KDIGO 2012 AKI); DIC managed by treating its cause, with platelets, plasma or fibrinogen guided by the tests for bleeding or procedures; temperature control (active fever prevention) while she remains comatose; why brain prognosis waits for multimodal assessment at least 72 hours after ROSC, off sedation (ERC–ESICM 2025); and how to separate 'can her organ failure be supported?' from 'will her brain recover?' when agreeing goals with the family. Never reports a result the learner has not read; never invents blood-gas, platelet, clotting or creatinine values, urine volumes, vasopressors or bleeding (none is recorded); never reveals the recorded outcome early.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：镜像右位心患者的复苏后心肌梗死——从心电图、导管室到家属谈话
title.en: Debrief: a post-arrest infarction in a mirror-image heart — from the ECG to the catheter laboratory and the family conversation

conclusion.zh-CN: 66岁女性住院期间胸闷后很快呼之不应、心跳呼吸骤停，经抢救和 4 次电击后仍昏迷：自主呼吸弱，双瞳孔散大、对光反射消失，四肢冰冷发绀，心尖搏动在右侧，心音低弱。急诊心电图示阵发性房颤、室速和前壁导联 ST 段抬高；胸片为镜像右位心、心影增大。造影：右冠状动脉近段完全闭塞伴局部血栓（罪犯病变），左主干狭窄 70%，前降支弥漫病变最重 85%、TIMI 3 级血流。记录中的团队先溶栓，后行右冠状动脉支架并置入 IABP；术后 ST 段回落，但出现无尿、酸中毒加重和 DIC，停止进一步抢救，PCI 后约 10 小时离院，此后结局不明。诊断：镜像右位心患者的急性 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死并发院内心脏骤停。按现行指南（ESC 2023 ACS；ERC–ESICM 2025）：确保气道，立即对罪犯血管行直接 PCI（早期昏迷不能说明治疗徒劳），能及时行 PCI 时不溶栓，主动预防发热，复苏后至少 72 小时再判断脑功能，并如实与家属沟通。
conclusion.en: A 66-year-old inpatient developed chest tightness, stopped responding and arrested; after resuscitation with four shocks she stayed unconscious, breathing weakly, with dilated unreactive pupils, cold cyanosed limbs, a right-sided apex beat and faint heart sounds. The ECG showed paroxysmal AF, VT and anterior-lead ST elevation; the chest film, mirror-image dextrocardia and cardiomegaly. Angiography: complete proximal RCA occlusion with thrombus (the culprit), left main 70 %, LAD to 85 % with TIMI 3 flow. Diagnosis: acute STEMI with an in-hospital arrest in mirror-image dextrocardia. The team gave thrombolysis, then stented the RCA with an IABP; the ST elevation fell, but anuria, worsening acidosis and DIC followed, resuscitation was stopped and she left about 10 hours after PCI, fate unknown. Today (ESC 2023 ACS; ERC–ESICM 2025): secure the airway, culprit PCI at once (an early coma does not make it futile), no lysis where timely PCI is available, prevent fever, judge the brain no earlier than 72 hours, and talk honestly with the family.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 胸闷之后很快呼之不应、需要电击的院内心脏骤停，首先要找冠状动脉原因；确保气道和通气之后，下一项检查就是心电图。
keyReasoning.en: An in-hospital arrest that needed shocks, after chest tightness, puts a coronary cause first; once the airway and ventilation are secured, the ECG is the next test.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 心尖搏动在右侧（加上心音低弱）说明心脏本身在右边——电极接错改变不了心尖的位置——所以按导联名称定位的结论不可靠。
keyReasoning.en: A right-sided apex beat (with faint heart sounds) means the heart itself is on the right — no electrode error moves the apex — so localising by lead names is unreliable.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 复苏后 ST 段抬高、发病前有胸闷，就要急诊造影；昏迷要纳入获益与风险的权衡，但在这么早的时候，昏迷和瞳孔都不能说明治疗徒劳。
keyReasoning.en: ST elevation after ROSC preceded by chest tightness means emergency angiography; her coma counts in the benefit–risk judgement, but this early neither it nor her pupils can show that treatment would be futile.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 造影上，有血栓的右冠状动脉近段完全闭塞才是罪犯病变；左主干 70% 和前降支 85%（TIMI 3 级血流）是留待以后处理的非罪犯病变。
keyReasoning.en: On the angiogram the thrombotic, completely occluded proximal RCA is the culprit; the 70 % left main and 85 % LAD lesions with TIMI 3 flow are non-culprit disease for later.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: PCI 后 ST 段回落只说明血管通了；无尿、酸中毒加重和 DIC 是新的问题——多器官衰竭——需要各自的决定，以及与家属的坦诚沟通。
keyReasoning.en: ST resolution after PCI shows only that the artery is open; anuria, worsening acidosis and DIC are a new problem — multi-organ failure — that needs decisions of its own and an honest family conversation.

boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show whether the outcome would have differed without lysis, with earlier PCI or with other post-arrest care, or whether her brain could have recovered. No vital signs, arrest rhythm or duration, laboratory values or events after she left hospital are recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 床旁发现心尖搏动在右侧，就要想到右位心并核对心电图。标准导联下镜像右位心表现为 I 导联 P 波、QRS 波和 T 波倒置，aVR 直立，胸导联 R 波从 V1 到 V6 逐渐变小；左右上肢电极接反只改变肢体导联，胸导联 R 波递增正常，也不会把心尖移到右边。应加做镜像导联心电图（左右上肢电极互换，胸导联移到右胸对称位置）：标准胸导联放在左胸时，位于形态学右心室之上，“前壁导联”的 ST 段抬高可能反映的是右心室受累——与本例右冠状动脉近段闭塞相符，但本病例没有记录导联是怎样放置的。记录与现行做法：本例镜像导联心电图是否做过没有记录；加做这份心电图不能拖延再灌注。
teachingPoints.en: A right-sided apex beat at the bedside should prompt the thought of dextrocardia and a check of the ECG. On standard leads, mirror-image dextrocardia shows inverted P, QRS and T in lead I, an upright aVR and R waves shrinking from V1 to V6; swapped arm electrodes change only the limb leads, leave a normal chest-lead progression and cannot move the apex. Add a mirror-image ECG (arm electrodes swapped, chest electrodes mirrored onto the right chest): standard chest electrodes on the left lie over the morphological right ventricle, so 'anterior' ST elevation may reflect right-ventricular injury — consistent with this patient's proximal RCA occlusion, though the case does not record how the leads were placed. Then and now: whether a mirror-image ECG was taken is not recorded, and taking one must never delay reperfusion.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 复苏后心电图持续 ST 段抬高，就按 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死启动直接 PCI 策略（ESC 2023 ACS；该指南在权衡获益与风险时考虑神经系统状况，但早期昏迷和尚不能解读的瞳孔并不能证明治疗徒劳）；能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成 PCI 时，直接 PCI 优于溶栓；阿司匹林负荷（静脉 75–250 mg 或经胃管 150–300 mg），PCI 时普通肝素 70–100 U/kg。中国 STEMI 指南（2019）同样以直接 PCI 为首选再灌注方式。记录与现行做法：记录中的团队先给溶栓、后行右冠状动脉支架，选择溶栓的原因和预计的 PCI 延误都没有记录；为等待导管室而先给全量溶栓、随后立即 PCI，在 ASSENT-4 PCI 试验（2006）中增加了不良事件和卒中。
teachingPoints.en: Persistent ST elevation after resuscitation calls for a primary PCI strategy (ESC 2023 ACS, which weighs neurological status against futility — and an early coma, with pupils that cannot yet be interpreted, does not establish futility); primary PCI is preferred to fibrinolysis whenever it can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis, with an aspirin load (75–250 mg IV, or 150–300 mg by nasogastric tube) and unfractionated heparin 70–100 U/kg at PCI. The Chinese STEMI guideline (2019) likewise makes primary PCI the preferred reperfusion. Then and now: the recorded team gave thrombolysis and then stented the RCA, and why lysis was chosen and the expected delay to PCI are not recorded; full-dose lysis given while waiting for an immediate PCI increased adverse events and strokes in ASSENT-4 PCI (2006).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 复苏后仍昏迷的患者，ERC–ESICM 2025 的首要处置是：确保气道并控制通气（SpO₂ 94%–98%，PaCO₂ 正常，避免高氧和过度通气），避免低血压（平均动脉压 > 60–65 mmHg），尽早记录 12 导联心电图，持续监测核心体温并主动预防发热，目标体温 ≤ 37.5 ℃，持续 36–72 小时；ESC 2023 ACS 成文于这次更新之前，把需要预防的发热定义为 > 37.7 ℃。记录与现行做法：本例的气道处理、通气、血压和体温都没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: For a patient who stays comatose after ROSC, ERC–ESICM 2025 puts first: a secured airway with controlled ventilation (SpO₂ 94–98 %, a normal PaCO₂, no hyperoxaemia or hyperventilation), no hypotension (a mean arterial pressure above 60–65 mmHg), an early 12-lead ECG, and continuous core-temperature monitoring with active prevention of fever, targeting 37.5 °C or less for 36–72 hours; ESC 2023 ACS, written before this update, defines the fever to prevent as above 37.7 °C. Then and now: her airway management, ventilation, blood pressure and temperature are not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 罪犯病变看的是血管闭塞和血栓，而不是狭窄程度或导联名称：本例前降支最重 85% 但仍有 TIMI 3 级血流，右冠状动脉近段完全闭塞伴血栓。ESC 2023 ACS 对稳定的患者推荐完全血运重建（首次 PCI 时或 45 天内），对心源性休克则推荐首次手术只做罪犯血管 PCI（CULPRIT-SHOCK，2017）；她刚经历骤停、灌注不良、血压没有记录，不能算稳定，所以急诊手术只处理罪犯病变，左主干病变交给心脏团队。没有机械并发症的心源性休克不常规使用 IABP（IABP-SHOCK II，2012）。记录与现行做法：记录中的团队对右冠状动脉置入支架并使用了 IABP，IABP 的指征没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: The culprit is defined by occlusion and thrombus, not by the degree of narrowing or the lead names: here the LAD's worst lesion was 85 % with TIMI 3 flow, while the proximal RCA was completely occluded with thrombus. ESC 2023 ACS recommends complete revascularisation (at the index PCI or within 45 days) for stable patients, but PCI of the culprit only at the index procedure in cardiogenic shock (CULPRIT-SHOCK, 2017); just after an arrest, with poor perfusion and no recorded blood pressure, she is not stable, so the emergency procedure treats the culprit and the left main goes to the Heart Team. Routine IABP is not recommended in shock without a mechanical complication (IABP-SHOCK II, 2012). Then and now: the recorded team stented the RCA and used an IABP whose indication is not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 复苏后早期的瞳孔散大、对光反射消失不能用来决定治疗：ERC–ESICM 2025 要求在复苏后至少 72 小时、排除镇静等干扰后进行多模式预后评估（如 ≥ 72 小时双侧瞳孔和角膜反射消失、体感诱发电位 N20 消失、高度恶性脑电图、神经元特异性烯醇化酶升高、弥漫性缺氧性脑损伤影像）。因多器官衰竭（本例的无尿、酸中毒加重和 DIC）而限制治疗是另一类决定，可以更早作出，但要依据她的意愿与家属共同商定（KDIGO 2012 指南把危及生命的酸碱和容量紊乱列为紧急肾脏替代治疗的指征）。记录与现行做法：本例在 PCI 后约 10 小时停止抢救并离院，由谁、因何决定没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Early dilated, unreactive pupils must not drive treatment after ROSC: ERC–ESICM 2025 requires multimodal prognostication no earlier than 72 hours after ROSC, once sedation and other confounders are excluded (for example bilaterally absent pupillary and corneal reflexes at 72 hours or later, absent N20 somatosensory evoked potentials, a highly malignant EEG, a raised neuron-specific enolase, diffuse anoxic injury on imaging). Limiting treatment for multi-organ failure — here anuria, worsening acidosis and DIC — is a different decision that can come earlier, but is agreed with the family in line with her wishes (KDIGO 2012 lists life-threatening acid–base and fluid disturbance as reasons for urgent renal replacement). Then and now: resuscitation was stopped about 10 hours after PCI and she left hospital; who decided and why are not recorded.
